author: SGMC
body:
Okay, so let's get straight to it. This is my winter themed walls map... before any more questions are asked, it is not intended to be a copy of permafrost; in my opinion that map has a more abandoned, wasteland-y feel to it, I tried to make this one be more positive, supported by the center being a giant Christmas tree. It is set in a pretty simple snowy biome, with a couple small wooden cottages and shacks. There is also a small frozen farm located at the base of a small mountain with a waterfall. There is a larger spruce tree with a chest inside its hollow top, which could be a valuable place for skybases. It includes a surface cave which extends in many directions, and is navigable with the supplied minecarts and railroad track leading into the depths. In between the sections, the ground is made entirely of ice which could cause a different PvP experience than other maps may offer. Hidden inside the tree are an almost broken gold sword with sharpness 4, fire aspect 2, knockback 2, and looting 3. This was inspired by the Village's troll sword. There is also a bow with power 1, punch 2, and flame 1. Each side has an enchanting table. The chests in the ice paths between sections have the usual speed and regeneration splash potions. I've made sure that the maps are completely surrounded in bedrock and are inescapable, and the map has been tested and played on multiple times. Here are a few screenshots to give you an idea of what the map is like. 
Center:Various buildings in the sections:
The .yml is included in the world download. Please note that this is my first time making one, so it might not be perfect, but I followed the instructions and it matches up with the .yml s of the other walls maps.
Comments? Questions? Suggestions? Please ask :D
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/b76j93d8dlmyp1a/Winter_walls_map_v1.0.zip
